observations.navigation_scope: Navigation request to encoded document PNG availability, fresh process/profile/cache, 1024x768 CSS pixels, recorded device scale, cached fixture replayed over loopback HTTP. Vox native markers exclude PNG file write; Brave CDP response includes base64/IPC delivery and readiness polling. Vox requests its initial navigation before presenting its first native window frame; Brave creates and resizes an about:blank window before the measured navigation request. Both browsers use inactive native windows on the display away from the pointer. Exclusive resource coalitions include exited helpers and coalition-owned Metal compiler and CascadeSets update services; GPU execution and services outside the coalition are excluded. Full story/comment-row identity is checked after the measured PNG endpoint. The asymmetric window setup makes this interval diagnostic only.
